title: Deployment Velocity Lighthouse — Daily KPI Digest & Readiness Checklist
content:
Purpose:
A compact daily digest for product-ops + on-call SREs to track KPIs, canary progress, and go/no-go signals during phased rollout. Not exhaustive — this is the single source to check before approving next ramp step.

TL;DR (one-line):
Canary healthy if 5m latency p50 < 220ms, error rate < 0.5%, user-facing regression rate < 0.3% and quality eval pass-rate >= 95% on sentinel prompts. If any yellow trigger persists for >30m, pause ramp and notify owners.

Scope:
- Applies to hosted-api releases and model variant swaps via the rollout controller.
- Covers traffic ramp 0% -> 100% in stages: canary (0.5%), small (5%), medium (20%), full (100%).
- Cross-team: Product-Ops owns coordination; Eng/SRE owns infra signals; Model Ops owns quality checks.

Primary contacts (owners):
- Product-Ops lead: Maya Chen (owner)
- SRE on-call: Ravi Kapoor
- Model Ops: Evelyn Park
- Support escalation lead: Jonah Ruiz
- Comms / PM: Samira Ali

Daily KPI snapshot (24h rolling unless noted):
- Total requests: 1,482,303
- Canary requests (last 1h): 7,410
- p50 latency (ms): 195
- p95 latency (ms): 412
- p99 latency (ms): 860
- Error rate (5xx): 0.31%
- Client error rate (4xx): 0.67%
- Timeouts: 0.02%
- Model quality regression (sentinel evals): 94.7% pass (target >=95%)
- Semantic fuzz (human-sampled drift): 2/50 flagged
- Token cost delta vs baseline: +6.2%
- Request cost per 1k: $1.09

Acceptance criteria for moving to next phase (check all):
- Infra: p95 latency within target band (<500ms) for 30m continuous AND no sustained error rate spikes (>1% for 15m).
- Quality: sentinel eval pass-rate >=95% (rolling) AND no high-severity hallucination reports in last 2h.
- Capacity: Dedicated pool buffer >=20% headroom or autoscale confirmed.
- Observability: All dashboards ingesting; tracing sample rate nominal.
- Stakeholders: Support rotation staffed; release owner sign-off present.

Phased traffic plan (recommended timeline):
- Canary 0.5% (duration: 2–6 hours) — aim for 4h median.
  - If metrics green after 4h, advance to 5%
- Small 5% (duration: 2–12 hours) — watch user cohorts for regression.
- Medium 20% (duration: 6–24 hours) — heavier tail conditions, consider weekend hour guardrails.
- Full 100% (duration: monitor 72h) — deprecate old variant after 72h stable.

Green/Yellow/Red triggers (automated & manual):
- Green: p95 < 500ms, error rate < 0.5%, quality pass >=95%
- Yellow (investigate): p95 500–800ms OR error rate 0.5–1.5% OR quality 90–95% OR 3+ user complaints in 30m
- Red (abort/rollback): p95 > 800ms for 15m OR error rate >1.5% for 10m OR quality <90% OR any high-severity user-impacting regression

Automations and runbook steps (quick):
1) Yellow detected -> Create JIRA linked to rollout (tag: rollout-hotfix) and ping #prod-ops + @oncall-sre.
2) Triage: check infra metrics, model metric stream, and latest prompts via sentinel dashboard.
3) If root cause infra: scale pool or reroute; if model: rollback to previous variant; if undetermined after 30m, pause ramp.
4) Red -> immediate rollback to previous model variant + traffic re-route to fallback region; open incident in PagerDuty; inform CS and PM.

Observability checklist (must be green):
- Dashboards: deployment-velocity, latency-traces, error-bucket, sentinel-quality (links pinned)
- Logs: streaming enabled, retention for 72h for this rollout
- Traces: top-50 slow traces flagged and sampled
- Alerts: silence noisy alerts; ensure high-priority routed to oncall

Quality monitoring details:
- Sentinel set: 120 prompts covering critical intents (billing, auth, data deletion, legal).
- Eval cadence: automated every 15m on canary traffic; human sample 50/day.
- Regression handling: any semantic failure labeled with failure type and triaged within 4h.

Capacity & cost guardrails:
- Autoscale floor: 3 nodes; max burst: +50% for 30m; sustained >30% burst triggers ops review.
- Cost gate: if cost per 1k requests increases >15% vs baseline for >1h, pause further ramp and notify finance owner (Priya Choudhary).

Communications & stakeholder cadence:
- Pre-ramp: 30m briefing to PM, SRE, Model Ops, Support.
- Ramp checkpoints: end of canary (4h), end of small (12h), pre-medium, pre-full.
- Channels: #prod-ops (primary), #release-comm (broadcast), pager duty for P1.
- Customer comms template: use /templates/release-notice.md; CS to prepare proactive notes for top 25 accounts if medium->full.

Post-launch tasks (first 72h):
- 0–4h: confirm SLA baseline, check critical customer flows, sample 100 end-to-end queries.
- 4–24h: complete human QA sweep on high-risk intents; reconcile token cost deltas.
- 24–72h: run regression evals across top-10 prompts, and finalize runbook updates.
- Cleanup: deprecate temporary feature flags, confirm telemetry retention settings.

Open action items (quick bullets):
- [ ] Add two more billing-scenario cases to sentinel set — Evelyn (JIRA-4498)
- [ ] Confirm burst capacity in ap-southeast-1 with infra — Ravi (JIRA-4501)
- [ ] Draft customer-facing FAQ for potential latency fluctuations — Samira (PR-1256)
- [ ] Update cost dashboard to surface model-token-delta by route — Maya (JIRA-4512)

Unknowns / notes to self:
- Are we sure the 95% sentinel target catches the UX regressions we care about? Need sampling plan for new A/B cohort.
- Verify that rollback time < 120s for variant swaps at scale (test in staging).
- Quick experiment: consider warm-starting KV caches for high-frequency prompts during canary.

References / quick links:
- Confluence: GO-123 deploy playbook (see rollout checklist)
- Jira: JIRA-4489 (release epic), JIRA-4498, JIRA-4501, JIRA-4512
- GH PR: runtimes/pull/1234 (model variant selector)

Appendix (condensed table for paste into dashboard widget):
- kpi_total_requests: "1,482,303"
- kpi_canary_requests_1h: "7,410"
- kpi_p50_ms: "195"
- kpi_p95_ms: "412"
- kpi_error_rate_pct: "0.31"
- kpi_quality_pass_pct: "94.7"

End-of-day notes (template):
- Summary (2–3 lines)
- KPI deltas vs baseline
- Incidents / actions taken
- Recommendation for next step (hold / advance / rollback)

-- Maya C. (product-ops)
Notes: keep this doc lightweight; update the numbers each morning and before any phase transition.
